scope: S10 Privacy/Retention/Audit settings desktop acceptance against the frozen S10 contract (descriptor settings.privacy-retention)

cases.name: Login establishes an admin session
cases.expectation: login succeeds and the S10 settings panel renders

cases.name: S10 page is available
cases.expectation: /dashboard/settings/privacy-retention renders 隐私、留存与审计设置 with the settings.privacy-retention.v1 descriptor

cases.name: Fresh fixture shows compiled defaults
cases.expectation: effective policy shows retentionMonths 24 with compiled_default projection, no publications, and honestly degraded readiness (cleanup_consumer_unavailable)

cases.name: Read-only actor sees no write controls
cases.expectation: read-only profile renders no 创建草稿 control and no publish capability

cases.name: Future-unavailable surfaces are disabled
cases.expectation: authenticated consent checkbox is disabled and the capability layering banner shows current_fact / future_unavailable

cases.name: Create a structurally valid draft succeeds
cases.expectation: a draft with retentionMonths 36 and consent_events 730 days is accepted and listed

cases.name: Out-of-range value is rejected with a field error
cases.expectation: retentionMonths 5 shows a field error and no draft is created

cases.name: High-risk auto-cleanup is blocked client-side
cases.expectation: orders autoCleanupEnabled is rejected at save time with 禁止启用自动清理 and no draft value change

cases.name: Legal-hold conflict is blocked client-side
cases.expectation: legalHoldEnabled with any auto-cleanup is rejected at save time with 不得启用自动清理 and no draft value change

cases.name: Validate the valid draft as validated
cases.expectation: validate reports 验证通过 with no blockers

cases.name: Safe diff shows the exact public value change
cases.expectation: diff lists consentPolicy.retentionMonths 24 -> 36 with public sensitivity and zero secrets

cases.name: Publish executes and reports honestly degraded readiness
cases.expectation: publish succeeds with a positive generation and the panel states the cleanup consumer is unavailable (never fake-ready)

cases.name: Published policy is effective; readiness stays degraded
cases.expectation: overview shows projectionState published with retentionMonths 36 and readiness remains degraded cleanup_consumer_unavailable even with an exact consumer generation

cases.name: History is append-only with original publication facts
cases.expectation: published entries keep their original auditEventId

cases.name: Rollback creates a draft and republishes at a higher generation
cases.expectation: rollback-draft returns a rollback_draft with rollbackOfPublicationId set; publishing it yields a generation above the superseded one and the restored value

cases.name: Stale version yields VERSION_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: a stale expectedVersion yields a controlled 409 VERSION_CONFLICT

cases.name: Illegal state yields SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: publishing an unvalidated draft yields a controlled 409 SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT

cases.name: Malformed UUID yields a controlled 400
cases.expectation: a non-UUID draft id returns a stable 400, never a 500

cases.name: Impact preview blocks high-risk auto-cleanup
cases.expectation: payments autoCleanupEnabled is blocked with blockedHighRiskFamilies [payments] and the panel shows the blocked notice

cases.name: Impact preview reports legal-hold conflict
cases.expectation: with an active legal hold, consent_events autoCleanupEnabled returns wouldConflictWithLegalHold true and the panel shows the conflict

cases.name: Impact preview requires a candidate change
cases.expectation: no candidate change yields a client-side rejection and an empty candidates request yields a controlled 400

cases.name: Audit safe snapshot carries real roles and no value fields
cases.expectation: mutation Audit rows carry effectiveRoles/grants and metadata only with descriptorKey; no consent/retention/legal-hold value fields

cases.name: Logout and post-logout state are clean
cases.expectation: logout returns to login and no protected settings state remains
